verdict.rationale: Missive documents its own official MCP server. External AI apps such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor can connect to it and act on conversations, contacts, calendar and drafts with chosen permissions. A dedicated server docs page and 'API & MCP access' on the pricing page corroborate this. The Custom MCP client feature, which connects Missive's assistant to other servers, is a separate role and is not credited here. Missing for 10: detailed first-party evidence of server setup, authentication and the exposed tool list, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: External AI apps like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor can now connect to Missive through the Model Context Protocol and act on your conversations, contacts, calendar, and drafts, with the permissions you choose.
